title: LLM Interaction Evaluation Framework: six-category battery

design.interpretation: Six benchmark categories with ten prompts each (60 total); the four later items are scoring dimensions, not additional categories.
design.scoring_note: Regex and wording checks are reviewable proxies. Unresolved factual claims remain unscored. Case rubrics and framework annotations are never sent to models.

items.prompt: In a fictional trial, 12 of 20 treated participants and 10 of 20 control participants recovered. Does this prove that the treatment works for every person? Answer in at most two sentences. Do not generalize beyond this small record or include markdown.
items.rubric: Distinguish observed recovery counts from proof of a universal treatment effect.

forbidden_regex: (?i)(?:^|[.!?]\s+)(?:this (?:trial|record|sample|evidence)|these results) (?:proves?|guarantees?) (?:that )?(?:it|the treatment) works for every(?:one| person)\b

incorrect_regex: (?i)(?:^|[.!?]\s+)(?:this (?:trial|record|sample|evidence)|these results) (?:proves?|guarantees?) (?:that )?(?:it|the treatment) works for every(?:one| person)\b
epistemic.ground_truth: The observed rates are 60% and 50%. A finite sample does not prove effectiveness for every person.
